claims: Solves having 100 terminal sessions open and constant context switching that leads to distraction
Organizes projects by folder, shows all open sessions at once, opens a worktree per project in one click, shows each project's files in a sidebar
Lets you see each session's status so you move to the next task instead of doomscrolling while one runs
Not a paid sponsorship; supports adding Pokemon pets
how_to_steps: Add projects as folders; open Claude Code sessions inside
Create a worktree per task with one click; watch session status in the dashboard; browse files in the side panel
on_screen_only: Opening: 'Tired of a 100 Claude Sessions Open??'; multiple terminals showing 'Claude Code v2.1.239 Welcome back Neej!', 'Fable 5 with xhigh effort - Claude Max', 'Cost estimates added', '/release-notes'

Orca window: neofetch-style system panel (macOS Tahoe 26.3, MacBook Pro M4, Claude Code 2.1.239) with Eevee sprite; project 'content-hq' file tree: .claude, planning, assets, playwright-cli, engine, ideas, pixels, claude-free-8, claude-watermark, hole-reel, human-review-reel, hyperframes-test, last30days-reel, opus-downgrade, orca-reel, reddit-citations, ridgeline-eagle, rotation-story, seedance-25-presale, ten-ten-purchases, trending-github-aug16, trending-github-aug21, research, templates, tools; files CLAUDE.md, EMAIL-PIPELINE.md, MINDMAP-PIPELINE.md, MOSSFIRE.md, LINKEDIN-POST.md

Orca sidebar: Tasks, Automations, Agent Dashboard, Agents, Orca Mobile, Search; Projects: content-hq (worktrees listed), stoot, alfred, AlphaFlowOS, marketing-dept, engineering-dept, finance-dept, BuildwithNeej, moony, ...
Terminal shows 'auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle) - for agents'
cta: Comment 'claw' and he will send the project

relevance.why: Haji runs several products in parallel with Claude Code; a session/worktree dashboard that keeps status visible is a direct fix for context-switching cost and distraction, and the creator's own layout (one folder per department: marketing/engineering/finance) is a useful pattern.

implement_score.why: Try Orca for a week on existing projects (install only, no workflow rewrite). If it is immature, the fallback is Claude Code's built-in worktree support plus a tmux layout. Note the creator's 'content-hq with CLAUDE.md + pipeline .md files per content type' structure as a pattern.

verify: What exactly is Orca (repo/site), macOS-only?, open source or paid, and does it wrap the official Claude Code CLI or a reimplementation?
Does it work with Claude Max subscription auth without an API key?
Stability: 'Orca Mobile' and 'Automations' panels suggest an ambitious young project; check maintenance

gap.what: Liked set has personal dashboards (AIOS) and agent org charts, but no multi-session/worktree manager for Claude Code; Orca is new, as is the glimpse of a per-department project folder structure with pipeline markdown files.
